question.worked_solution:
The difference of cubes formula is given by

$$
{a}^{3}-{b}^{3}=(a-b)({a}^{2}+ab+{b}^{2}).
$$

Notice that we can write our expression as a difference of cubes, as follows:

$$
\frac{8}{{w}^{3}}-\frac{1}{{z}^{9}}={(\frac{2}{w})}^{3}-{(\frac{1}{{z}^{3}})}^{3}
$$

Now, we factor our expression using the difference of cubes formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{8}{{w}^{3}}-\frac{1}{{z}^{9}} & ={(\frac{2}{w})}^{3}-{(\frac{1}{{z}^{3}})}^{3} \\  & =(\frac{2}{w}-\frac{1}{{z}^{3}})({(\frac{2}{w})}^{2}+\frac{2}{w}\cdot \frac{1}{{z}^{3}}+{(\frac{1}{{z}^{3}})}^{2}) \\  & =(\frac{2}{w}-\frac{1}{{z}^{3}})(\frac{4}{{w}^{2}}+\frac{2}{w{z}^{3}}+\frac{1}{({z}^{3})^{2}}) \\  & =(\frac{2}{w}-\frac{1}{{z}^{3}})(\frac{4}{{w}^{2}}+\frac{2}{w{z}^{3}}+\frac{1}{{z}^{6}})\end{aligned}
$$
